hypothesis: Kotlin SAM conversion handles java.util.function types transparently, so the call sites in demo() will drop the explicit (Runnable) and (Supplier<String>) casts and become unresolved overload ambiguities. J2K may not insert the required SAM constructor syntax (Runnable { ... }) needed to re-disambiguate.

J2K retains the try-catch wrapper inside stream lambda bodies rather than hoisting it. The ThrowingFunction @FunctionalInterface becomes a Kotlin fun interface, but the wrap() helper may be converted with a redundant check for RuntimeException that is already covered by Kotlin's unchecked exception model.

Kotlin annotation classes do not support @Target with mixed TYPE and METHOD in a single declaration. J2K may split them correctly, but the @Repeatable pattern requires a companion @JvmRepeatable annotation that J2K does not add, and composed @SpringMvcAnnotation meta-annotations may lose their defaults.

J2K converts the class to a Kotlin class with @JsonCreator constructor but does not convert it to a data class due to the non-trivial constructor body. The Optional<String> return type of getDescription() will not be simplified to String? and @JsonIgnore on isAdult() may be placed on the backing field rather than the getter, breaking Jackson visibility.
expectedIssues: @JsonIgnore misplaced on field instead of getter
convenience constructor kept as secondary rather than default params

hypothesis: Single-level enclosing field access (InnerClassShadowing.this.value) becomes this@InnerClassShadowing.value correctly. However the two-level InnerInner case (Inner.this.value) may be converted incorrectly or produce !! because J2K does not always track the intermediate outer reference through two nesting levels.

J2K recognises the return-this pattern in Builder and converts setters to functions returning Builder (or this@Builder). The covariant SecureBuilder.tls() override that returns SecureBuilder will not be recognised as a covariant override and J2K will retain an explicit cast or produce a type mismatch, requiring manual correction.
expectedIssues: covariant return type in SecureBuilder breaks after conversion
explicit cast added for covariant builder chain
